sentences.text: Paradise is the third extended play -LRB- EP -RRB- and second major release by American singer and songwriter Lana Del Rey ; it was released on November 9 , 2012 by Universal Music .	Lana Del Rey	Lana Del Rey	extended play	extended play	Universal Music	Universal Music

It is additionally packaged with the reissue of her second studio album Born to Die -LRB- 2012 -RRB- , titled Born to Die : The Paradise Edition .	Born to Die	Born to Die (Lana Del Rey album)	reissue	reissue	studio album	studio album
Del Rey enlisted collaborators including producers Rick Nowels , Justin Parker , and Rick Rubin .	Rick Nowels	Rick Nowels	Rick Rubin	Rick Rubin	Justin Parker	Justin Parker
Upon its release , Paradise received generally favorable reviews from music critics .	music critics	Music journalism
The extended play debuted at number 10 on the US Billboard 200 with first-week sales of 67,000 copies .	extended play	extended play
It also debuted at number 10 on the Canadian Albums Chart and peaked within the top-five of various other Billboard charts .	Canadian Albums Chart	Canadian Albums Chart

Charting across Europe , the extended play became a top-ten hit in Flanders and Poland , charting within the top twenty in Wallonia and the Netherlands .	extended play	extended play	top-ten hit	Chart-topper
The EP 's lead single was the ballad `` Ride '' which became a modest hit in the United States , Switzerland , Ireland , and France and reached the top ten in Russia .	Ride	Ride (Lana Del Rey song)
